name: The Twilight Zone Tower of Terror
description: The most iconic and terrifying attraction at Hollywood Studios — the Twilight Zone Tower of Terror is a legendary drop tower experience housed in a magnificently atmospheric abandoned Hollywood hotel. Guests board a haunted service elevator that plunges through multiple randomised freefall sequences in a spectacular supernatural storyline. Universally regarded as one of the greatest theme park attractions ever created. Min 102cm.

name: Rock 'n' Roller Coaster starring Aerosmith
description: The most thrilling roller coaster at Walt Disney World — Rock n Roller Coaster is a spectacular indoor launched coaster launching guests from 0 to 96 km/h in under 3 seconds through a twisting neon-lit highway in the dark to an Aerosmith soundtrack. One of the most intense and beloved coasters at any Disney park in the world. Min 122cm.

name: Millennium Falcon: Smugglers Run
description: The most immersive Star Wars attraction ever created — Millennium Falcon Smugglers Run places guests in the cockpit of the actual Millennium Falcon on a thrilling interactive smuggling mission. Pilots control the ship while gunners and engineers support in a spectacular collaborative adventure. The most technologically extraordinary interactive attraction at any Disney park. Min 97cm.

name: Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge
description: The most ambitious and immersive themed land ever created — Star Wars Galaxy's Edge is a breathtaking full-scale recreation of the Black Spire Outpost on the planet Batuu. Spanning 5.5 acres the land offers extraordinary immersion with unique food, drinks, merchandise and two spectacular attractions. Walking through Galaxy's Edge is a transcendent theme park experience unlike anything else in the world. Suitable for all ages.

name: Slinky Dog Dash
description: A beloved and thrilling family roller coaster at Toy Story Land — Slinky Dog Dash stretches Slinky the dog around a fun and exciting layout through the giant backyard of Andy's house. One of the most popular and rerideable family coasters at any Disney park in the world. Min 97cm.

name: Star Tours — The Adventures Continue
description: A classic and beloved Star Wars flight simulator at Hollywood Studios featuring over 70 unique adventure combinations through iconic Star Wars locations — Star Tours is one of the most rerideable attractions at any Disney park with a different experience virtually every time. Min 102cm.

name: Indiana Jones Epic Stunt Spectacular!
description: A legendary and beloved live stunt show at Hollywood Studios recreating iconic scenes from Raiders of the Lost Ark — the Indiana Jones Epic Stunt Spectacular features extraordinary live stunt performers, explosions and behind-the-scenes filmmaking insights. One of the longest-running and most beloved live shows at any theme park in the world. Suitable for all ages.

name: Alien Swirling Saucers
description: A charming and fun spinning flat ride at Toy Story Land featuring Little Green Men from Toy Story swooping in flying saucers in a fun and colourful alien play set. One of the most entertaining and accessible family attractions at Hollywood Studios. Suitable for all ages.

name: Muppet*Vision 3D
description: A classic and beloved Muppets 3D film experience at Hollywood Studios combining extraordinary Jim Henson Muppet characters with immersive 3D effects, physical special effects and Audio-Animatronic characters. One of the most charming and nostalgic attractions at any Disney park in the world. Suitable for all ages.

name: Echo Lake
description: A charming and atmospheric recreation of a classic Hollywood studio back lot at Hollywood Studios — Echo Lake features beautiful vintage theming, beloved dining destinations including the iconic 50's Prime Time Cafe and Sci-Fi Dine-In Theater, and classic Hollywood Studio atmosphere. Suitable for all ages.

name: Sunset Boulevard
description: The most atmospheric and beautifully themed street at Hollywood Studios — Sunset Boulevard is a spectacular recreation of the golden age of Hollywood featuring magnificent period architecture, the towering Tower of Terror, Rock n Roller Coaster and extraordinary live entertainment venues. Suitable for all ages.

name: Star Wars: Rise of the Resistance
description: The most technologically ambitious and immersive attraction ever created at any theme park — Star Wars Rise of the Resistance places guests inside a full-scale Star Destroyer in an extraordinary multi-system adventure combining trackless dark ride technology, flight simulators, massive sets and extraordinary Audio-Animatronics. The greatest theme park attraction of the modern era. Min 102cm.

name: Fantasmic!
description: The most spectacular nighttime show at any Disney park — Fantasmic! is an extraordinary outdoor amphitheater spectacular featuring Mickey Mouse battling the forces of evil through stunning water screen projections, live performers, beloved Disney characters and breathtaking pyrotechnics. One of the greatest live entertainment experiences at any theme park in the world. Suitable for all ages.
